prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1333; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented for evaluation of a right shoulder injury sustained when their vehicle was struck while turning left. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the reported symptoms, including pain with overhead reach and limited range of motion. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the injury to the shoulder. The patient has no known prior injury to this body area.

Over four visits, care followed a typical course of conservative management, including targeted exercises, activity modification, and pain control as needed. Symptoms and functional capacity improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly. At the most recent visit, the patient reported near-resolution of pain and was able to perform most daily activities without restriction.

Administrative note: two similar charges recorded on the same day are currently under review for accuracy. This review does not affect the clinical findings above.
